jobs.jd: Employer-description summary for initial test: Support IT risk and compliance governance, assess technology and vendor risks, maintain policies, assist customer due diligence, coordinate audit evidence and remediation, and track program metrics. Desired background includes IT audit, IT risk, compliance or information security; CISA, CRISC, CISSP or Security+; and familiarity with ISO/IEC, NIST, COBIT, PCI-DSS, GDPR or CMMI. Requires a degree or equivalent experience and strong communication and organization. The application requests availability, three technical skills, current salary and expected salary; candidate must supply these answers.
